entities.name: DL NAS TRANSPORT
entities.description: Downlink NAS transport message used to carry various payload types from network to UE.

entities.name: T3346
entities.description: Timer that is stopped upon reception of DL NAS TRANSPORT message.

entities.name: Payload container type IE
entities.description: Information element indicating the type of payload contained in the DL NAS TRANSPORT message.

entities.name: Payload container IE
entities.description: Information element containing the actual payload data in DL NAS TRANSPORT message.

entities.name: SOR transparent container
entities.description: Payload container type for Steering of Roaming information with integrity protection.

entities.name: UE parameters update transparent container
entities.description: Payload container type for UE parameters update with integrity protection.

entities.name: UL NAS TRANSPORT
entities.description: Uplink NAS transport message used to send acknowledgements for certain payload types.

entities.name: 5GMM cause IE
entities.description: Information element indicating the cause for certain network-initiated actions.

entities.name: Back-off timer value IE
entities.description: Information element containing timer values for congestion control scenarios.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED.NON-ALLOWED-SERVICE
entities.description: 5GMM state entered when service area restrictions apply.

entities.name: Integrity check passed
entities.description: Condition where payload container integrity verification succeeds.

entities.name: Integrity check failed
entities.description: Condition where payload container integrity verification fails.

relations.description: Reception of DL NAS TRANSPORT message stops timer T3346 if running.
DL NAS TRANSPORT message contains Payload container type IE.
DL NAS TRANSPORT message contains Payload container IE.
SOR transparent container processing requires successful integrity check.
Successful SOR processing with ACK bit set triggers UL NAS TRANSPORT acknowledgement.
UE parameters update container processing requires successful integrity check.
Successful UE parameters update with ACK bit set triggers UL NAS TRANSPORT acknowledgement.
DL NAS TRANSPORT message may contain 5GMM cause IE.
DL NAS TRANSPORT message may contain Back-off timer value IE.
Failed integrity check causes payload container IE to be discarded.
